_how_to_use: Every repo you own and have starred on GitHub shows up in the app automatically. Add an entry here (keyed by repo name) to give it a nicer title, a domain, a headline result and a stack. 'featured_order' sets the order in the default view; the first one gets the large lead card.

michelin-rag.title: Tire Industry Report Analyst
michelin-rag.result: A LangGraph agent that answers questions over 1,250 pages of tire-industry annual reports with page citations. It got 40 of 41 test questions right and refused every off-topic and prompt-injection attempt.

snowpark-customer-segmentation.title: Customer Segmentation
snowpark-customer-segmentation.result: Segments 4,261 customers by predicted next-quarter value and buying style. The top 20% capture 71% of next-quarter revenue, against 56% for standard RFM. Includes Segment Assistant, an LLM chat app for exploring the segments.

cmapss-predictive-maintenance.title: Predictive Maintenance
cmapss-predictive-maintenance.result: Flags turbofan engines 50 and 15 cycles before failure on NASA C-MAPSS data, catching about 91% of failures on held-out engines.

azure-automl-loan-default-prediction.title: Loan Default Prediction
azure-automl-loan-default-prediction.result: An ECOA-compliant model with an F2-tuned threshold that catches about 75% of defaults on a true holdout (AUC 0.76). Along the way it caught training-data leakage that had inflated the first estimate.

grid-stress-simulator.title: Grid Stress Simulator
grid-stress-simulator.result: Models how heat pump and EV adoption shift winter peak load across South Carolina counties. An 11 PM EV charging timer would create a new midnight peak above today's morning peak.
